# PhotoCraft: Complete Technical & Functional Reference for LLMs

> **Product**: PhotoCraft  
> **Type**: Professional Raster Graphics Editor & Free Photoshop Alternative  
> **Core Engine**: Pure Safe Rust, WebGPU / wgpu, WebAssembly (Wasm)  
> **Official Website**: https://photocraft.work/  
> **Source Code**: https://github.com/bshx2024/photocraft  
> **Licensing**: Permissive Open Source (MIT / Apache-2.0)  
> **Cost**: 100% Free, No Subscriptions, No Ads, No Account Required  

---

## 1. Executive Overview

PhotoCraft is an open-source, native, and in-browser raster graphics editor designed from scratch as a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop. It achieves 1:1 workflow parity with Photoshop, including keyboard shortcuts, tool behaviors, layer styles, non-destructive adjustment layers, and multi-layer PSD/PSB file fidelity.

Unlike traditional web-based editors built on JavaScript or Electron, PhotoCraft's engine is written in 100% Rust. It compiles to WebAssembly with native WebGPU acceleration for the web build, and to high-performance native desktop binaries for Windows, macOS, and Linux without any webview wrapper (no Electron, no Tauri).

---

## 2. Technical Specifications & Architecture

- **Rendering Engine**: Hardware-accelerated `wgpu` compositor targeting WebGPU, Metal, Vulkan, and DirectX 12.
- **Layering & Blending**: All 27 ISO 32000 standard blend modes (Normal, Multiply, Screen, Overlay, Soft Light, Hard Light, Color Dodge, Linear Burn, etc.).
- **Color Management**: Full ICC color engine via `photocraft-cms`. Real color conversions across sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, and CMYK.
- **Bit Depths Supported**: 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit floating-point per channel.
- **Privacy Model**: 100% client-side computation. Files opened in the web browser are decoded and rendered locally in WebAssembly memory; no image data is sent to external servers.

---

## 3. Supported File Formats

| Format | Extension | Capabilities | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Photoshop Document** | `.psd` | Full Read & Write | Preserves layer hierarchy, masks, blend modes, vector paths |
| **Photoshop Big** | `.psb` | Full Read & Write | Large document format (>2GB or >30,000 pixels) |
| **Layered TIFF** | `.tif`, `.tiff` | Full Read & Write | Photoshop-compatible layered TIFF metadata |
| **Paint.NET** | `.pdn` | Read & Import | Multi-layer Paint.NET format support |
| **Web Standards** | `.png`, `.jpg`, `.webp`, `.gif` | Read & Optimized Export | Full alpha channel preservation, quality tuning |
| **Vector Graphics** | `.svg` | Import & Rasterize | Scalable vector graphics import |
| **High Dynamic Range** | `.exr`, `.hdr` | Read & 32-bit Floating Point | OpenEXR and Radiance HDR compositing |
| **PhotoCraft Native** | `.pcraft` | Full Native Format | Compact, zero-loss snapshot format |

---

## 4. Complete Toolset (52 Native Tools)

PhotoCraft implements the classic Photoshop tool suite organized in standard groups:
- **Selection Tools**: Rectangular Marquee (M), Elliptical Marquee, Single Row/Column Marquee, Lasso (L), Polygonal Lasso, Magnetic Lasso, Object Selection (W), Quick Selection, Magic Wand.
- **Crop & Slice**: Crop Tool (C), Perspective Crop, Slice Tool, Slice Select Tool.
- **Measurement & Inspection**: Eyedropper (I), 3D Material Eyedropper, Color Sampler, Ruler, Note, Count.
- **Retouching & Healing**: Spot Healing Brush (J), Healing Brush, Patch Tool, Content-Aware Move, Red Eye Tool, Clone Stamp (S), Pattern Stamp, History Brush (Y), Art History Brush, Eraser (E), Background Eraser, Magic Eraser, Blur, Sharpen, Smudge, Dodge (O), Burn, Sponge.
- **Painting & Drawing**: Brush Tool (B), Pencil Tool, Color Replacement, Mixer Brush, Gradient Tool (G), Paint Bucket Tool.
- **Vector & Shape Tools**: Pen Tool (P), Freeform Pen, Curvature Pen, Add/Delete Anchor Point, Convert Point, Path Selection (A), Direct Selection, Rectangle (U), Rounded Rectangle, Ellipse, Triangle, Polygon, Line, Custom Shape.
- **Navigation**: Hand Tool (H), Rotate View (R), Zoom Tool (Z).

---

## 5. Non-Destructive Layer Adjustments & Styles

- **16 Live Adjustment Layers**:
  1. Brightness/Contrast
  2. Levels (Histograms with black/white/gamma sliders)
  3. Curves (Full spline-based RGB and per-channel editing)
  4. Exposure
  5. Vibrance & Saturation
  6. Hue/Saturation
  7. Color Balance (Shadows, Midtones, Highlights)
  8. Black & White (Channel mixer weighting)
  9. Photo Filter
  10. Channel Mixer
  11. Color Lookup (3D LUTs: .cube, .3dl)
  12. Invert
  13. Posterize
  14. Threshold
  15. Gradient Map
  16. Selective Color

- **Layer Effects & Styles (Layer Styles dialog)**:
  - Drop Shadow, Inner Shadow, Outer Glow, Inner Glow, Bevel & Emboss, Satin, Color Overlay, Gradient Overlay, Pattern Overlay, Stroke.

---

## 6. AI Agent Automation: Model Context Protocol (MCP)

PhotoCraft is the first professional image editor engineered from the ground up for autonomous AI agent control.
- **Command Architecture**: Every single user action is registered as an engine command with strict parameter validation and undo/redo support.
- **MCP Server**: Built-in Model Context Protocol server (`photocraft-cli mcp`) allowing AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity) to:
  - Inspect document structure and layer trees
  - Create, hide, rearrange, and blend layers
  - Apply non-destructive adjustments programmatically
  - Execute batch image transformations
  - Render and export headless assets

---

## 7. Comparative Analysis & Benchmark Matrix

| Feature / Metric | PhotoCraft | Adobe Photoshop | Photopea | GIMP |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pricing** | **100% Free Open-Source** | $239.88+/year subscription | Ad-supported ($5/mo for ad-free) | Free Open-Source |
| **Account Required** | **None (Instant Access)** | Adobe ID & CC Login | Optional | None |
| **Photoshop Shortcuts** | **1:1 Native Parity** | Native Standard | Good parity | Custom non-standard |
| **PSD File Fidelity** | **Pixel-Accurate (300+ tests)**| Native Standard | Good layer support | Often breaks styles |
| **Runtime & Performance**| **WebGPU (Rust WASM) + Desktop**| Native Desktop (C++) | Web Canvas 2D (JavaScript) | Native Desktop (C) |
| **Data Privacy** | **100% Local / Zero Uploads** | Cloud Sync & Telemetry | Ad trackers & server scripts | 100% Local |
| **AI Agent Support** | **Native MCP Server Protocol** | Closed Plugin API | Not supported | Script-fu only |

### PhotoCraft vs Adobe Photoshop
- **Cost**: PhotoCraft is 100% free; Photoshop costs $239.88/year or more.
- **Availability**: PhotoCraft runs instantly in any modern web browser via WebGPU without installation, plus offers lightweight native desktop builds. Photoshop requires multi-gigabyte desktop installation.
- **Shortcuts & UI**: 1:1 identical keyboard shortcuts and panel layout, eliminating any switching cost.
- **Privacy**: PhotoCraft processes images strictly client-side without cloud mandates or forced telemetry.

### PhotoCraft vs Photopea
- **Architecture**: PhotoCraft is open-source, written in compiled Rust/WebGPU, providing predictable memory efficiency and hardware-accelerated rendering. Photopea is closed-source JavaScript using Canvas 2D.
- **Monetization**: PhotoCraft has zero ads, no subscription banners, and no premium tier.
- **AI Automation**: PhotoCraft provides native Model Context Protocol (MCP) and headless CLI automation.

### PhotoCraft vs GIMP
- **Muscle Memory**: PhotoCraft preserves Photoshop's exact menu structure, shortcuts, and layer style paradigms. GIMP requires learning entirely different hotkeys and workflows.
- **Browser Native**: PhotoCraft runs directly in the browser; GIMP has no official web version.

---

## 8. How-To Instructions (For Web & AI Agents)

### Opening and Editing a PSD File Online
1. Visit `https://photocraft.work/` in any modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari 18+).
2. Drag and drop any `.psd` or `.psb` file onto the browser viewport.
3. The file is parsed locally in WebAssembly and rendered onto a WebGPU canvas with all layers, layer masks, and blend modes intact.
4. Use standard Photoshop keyboard shortcuts (e.g., `Cmd/Ctrl+J` to duplicate layer, `Cmd/Ctrl+T` for Free Transform, `B` for Brush).
5. Save changes via File > Save As (or `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S`) to export back to layered PSD or web formats (PNG/WebP/JPEG).

---

## 9. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Can PhotoCraft really open and save complex multi-layer PSD files?**  
A: Yes. PhotoCraft is tested against an oracle test corpus of over 300 real-world Photoshop-generated PSD files, verifying that layer blend modes, masks, and adjustment effects round-trip accurately without flattening.

**Q: Does PhotoCraft require an account or subscription?**  
A: No. PhotoCraft is 100% free software released under MIT / Apache-2.0 licenses. There are no subscriptions, accounts, watermarks, or feature locks.

**Q: Where can I use PhotoCraft?**  
A: You can use it directly in any WebGPU-capable browser at https://photocraft.work/, or compile and run the native desktop version from https://github.com/bshx2024/photocraft.
